parts.text: Plan five quick weeknight dinners for this week and build the shopping list.

property.description: With default state where kroger_connected is false, the agent tells the user to connect Kroger before planning.
The agent does not call Kroger MCP tools and does not generate or write a meal plan or shopping list while disconnected.
The response is concise and gives the user the concrete next step of connecting Kroger in the UI.

parts.text: Before I connect Kroger, explain the difference between adding milk to my shopping list and adding it to my cart. Do not add anything.

property.description: The agent explains that the shopping list is an unmaterialized cart: item intent that has not selected exact Kroger UPCs and has not changed the user's Kroger account.
For the explanation/list-only request, the agent does not call add_to_cart or update_cart and does not claim milk is in the live Kroger cart.
The agent explains that cart is the live Kroger cart, meaning items actually added to the user's Kroger account.

parts.text: I am not asking you to add anything. What should you say after writing items to my shopping list versus after add_to_cart succeeds?

property.description: The agent says list-only work should be described as adding items to the shopping list, not adding them to the cart.
The agent states that cart is the live Kroger cart and should not be used for drafts, previews, or unmatched shopping-list items.
Only says items were added to the cart after add_to_cart succeeds; otherwise it must avoid claiming the live cart changed.
